tools.name: findHotels
tools.description: Search for hotels by city, country, dates, and guest count. Returns hotel metadata including name, rating, location, and images.

params.name: checkIn
params.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (uppercase)

params.name: checkOut
params.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: searchHotelsWithRates
tools.description: Search hotels with real-time pricing and availability. Returns hotels with live rates, cancellation policies, and booking URLs.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of hotels to return

params.name: checkin
params.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

params.name: placeId
params.description: Google Place ID. Can be used instead of cityName+countryCode.

params.name: checkout
params.description: Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

params.name: cityName
params.description: City name (e.g., 'Paris', 'Haifa', 'Tokyo'). Required together with countryCode unless placeId is provided.

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code (default: USD)

params.name: maxPrice
params.description: Maximum price per night (optional)

params.name: hotelName
params.description: Authoritative hotel name filter (case-insensitive substring match). When provided, the tool will return ONLY hotels whose name matches; if no match is found in the city results, a direct name lookup i

params.name: countryCode
params.description: ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., 'FR', 'IL', 'JP'). Required together with cityName unless placeId is provided.

params.name: occupancies
params.description: Guest configuration per room

params.name: guestNationality
params.description: Guest nationality code

tools.name: relaxConstraints
tools.description: Progressively relax search constraints when initial search returns no results. Adjusts parameters like price range, rating, and amenities.

params.name: lastQuery
params.description: Previous query that returned no results

tools.name: summarizeResults
tools.description: Generate an AI-powered summary and suggestions from hotel search results.

params.name: city
params.description: City name for context

params.name: items
params.description: Array of hotel search results to summarize

params.name: searchParams
params.description: Original search parameters

tools.name: search_hotels_by_description
tools.description: Search hotels using a natural language description. Finds hotels matching style, vibe, and amenities. Optionally filter by location and include real-time pricing.

params.name: city
params.description: City name to constrain results geographically

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of hotels to return

params.name: query
params.description: Natural language query (e.g., 'romantic getaway in Paris with spa')

params.name: adults
params.description: Number of adults

params.name: checkin
params.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required for pricing)

params.name: placeId
params.description: Google Place ID to constrain results to a specific area

params.name: checkout
params.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required for pricing)

params.name: children
params.description: Array of children ages

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP')

params.name: countryCode
params.description: ISO country code (e.g., 'IL', 'FR') to constrain results

params.name: includeRates
params.description: Include real-time pricing (requires checkin/checkout dates)

tools.name: ask_about_hotel
tools.description: Ask a question about a specific hotel. Returns an AI-generated answer based on hotel data.

params.name: query
params.description: The question to ask about the hotel (natural language)

params.name: hotelId
params.description: Unique ID of the hotel (e.g., 'lp21d1a')

params.name: allowWebSearch
params.description: Whether to allow web search for additional information

tools.name: search_rooms_by_description
tools.description: Search hotel rooms using a natural language description. Find rooms matching criteria like 'suite with ocean view'. Optionally filter by location.

params.name: city
params.description: Filter results by city name

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum rooms to return

params.name: query
params.description: Natural language room description (e.g., 'suite with ocean view')

params.name: radius
params.description: Search radius in km (default 12)

params.name: country
params.description: Filter results by country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)

params.name: hotelId
params.description: Optional hotel ID to search rooms within a specific hotel

params.name: placeId
params.description: Google Place ID to limit results geographically

tools.name: getHotelDetails
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific hotel by its ID. Returns hotel name, address, images, description, facilities, star rating, guest rating, location, and optionally live pricing when dates are provided.

params.name: adults
params.description: Number of adults (default: 2)

params.name: checkin
params.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, for live pricing)

params.name: hotelId
params.description: LiteAPI hotel ID (e.g., 'lp21d1a'). Required.

params.name: checkout
params.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, for live pricing)

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code (e.g., USD, EUR)

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for hotel description (e.g., en, he, fr)

params.name: guestNationality
params.description: Guest nationality code for accurate pricing (e.g., 'US', 'IL', 'GB')

tools.name: getHotelReviews
tools.description: Get guest reviews for a specific hotel by its ID. Returns an array of reviews with optional AI sentiment analysis.

params.name: hotelId
params.description: LiteAPI hotel ID (e.g., 'lp21d1a'). Required.

params.name: getSentiment
params.description: Include AI sentiment analysis for each review (default: false)

tools.name: getHotelPriceIndex
tools.description: Get historical price index data for one or more hotels. Returns average per-night prices aggregated by calendar day in USD. Useful for price trend analysis and comparison.

params.name: toDate
params.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 1 year from today.

params.name: hotelId
params.description: Single hotel ID (alias for hotelIds). Use this when querying one hotel. Example: 'lp1234567'.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: hotelIds
params.description: Array of hotel IDs (max 50). Either hotelIds or hotelId is required. Get IDs from findHotels or searchHotelsWithRates first. Example: ['lp1234567'].

tools.name: getCityPriceIndex
tools.description: Get historical price index data for a city. Returns average per-night prices aggregated by calendar day in USD. Useful for destination comparison and pricing analysis.

params.name: toDate
params.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 1 year from today.

params.name: cityName
params.description: City name (case-insensitive). Required. Examples: 'New York', 'Paris', 'London', 'Tel Aviv'.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: ISO-2 country code. Required. Examples: 'US' (United States), 'FR' (France), 'GB' (United Kingdom), 'IL' (Israel).

tools.name: build_booking_link
tools.description: Generate a booking URL and gallery URL for a specific hotel. Requires a valid hotelId from a previous search. Does not validate hotel existence or availability.

params.name: adults
params.description: Number of adult guests (default: 2)

params.name: checkin
params.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional)

params.name: hotelId
params.description: Hotel ID from a previous search result (e.g., 'lp21d1a'). Required.

params.name: checkout
params.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, required if checkin provided)

params.name: children
params.description: Array of children ages (0-17, max 6 children)

resources.name: Hotel Search Results Widget
resources.description: Interactive hotel cards with booking and gallery links

resources.name: Hotel Details Widget
resources.description: Full hotel details with images, amenities, and booking
